finding.comment: The reusable workflow reference was changed from a pinned full commit SHA to the mutable @main branch. Any push to acme-platform/deploy-kit's main branch now changes the code that runs in this repository's CI with access to DEPLOY_KEY, undoing the supply-chain pinning hardening.

files.patch:
--- a/.github/workflows/deploy.yml
+++ b/.github/workflows/deploy.yml
@@ -4,7 +4,7 @@
 jobs:
   ship:
-    uses: acme-platform/deploy-kit/.github/workflows/ship.yml@8f14e45fceea167a5a36dedd4bea2543aa76d1f4
+    uses: acme-platform/deploy-kit/.github/workflows/ship.yml@main
     with:
       env: production
     secrets:
       DEPLOY_KEY: ${{ secrets.DEPLOY_KEY }}

rationale: same diff, comment and vocabulary; only the added ref differs: demotion to @main vs re-pin to a new immutable SHA
